articles.title: HOW TO TELL WHEN YOUR USERS ARE LOSING INTEREST, BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE
articles.summary:
Most UX problems don't show up as obvious failures. They surface as hesitation, repeated clicks, and drop-off, yet by the time the signals are clear, the moment to act has passed.

This Datadog eBook [5] shows product managers how to pick up on signs that are normally spread across analytics, performance, and support tools. Topics include:

* 3 questions you should be able to answer about your users * The Pulse, Pain, and Proof framework [6] for organizing UX signals * How session-level visibility lets you diagnose problems with limited metrics
